# vengtoo_role_parent (Resource)

Makes one role inherit from another, so the child role picks up the parent's policies. The hierarchy is a DAG — an edge that would create a cycle is rejected.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent_id` (String) Parent role, whose policies are inherited.
- `role_id` (String) Child role, which inherits from the parent.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: role_id:parent_id
